cases.input: Projects P-A and P-B share tracker T and product X; each work item resolves its project explicitly.
cases.expect: P-A and P-B remain distinct; T and X create no project identity merge.

cases.input: Approved change CR-7 cites BL-1 and causes project P-A to issue BL-2.
cases.expect: BL-2 supersedes BL-1 with explicit effectivity while BL-1 remains resolvable.

cases.input: A deliverable accepted under criteria C1 is unchanged when BL-2 succeeds BL-1.
cases.expect: The acceptance remains pinned to C1 and is not silently rebound.

cases.input: BL-1 pins plan revision P-R7; the working plan later advances to P-R8 before BL-2 is approved.
cases.expect: BL-1 continues to resolve P-R7 and all historical variance remains reproducible.

cases.input: Only schedule changes; BL-2 is created with new schedule pins and the unchanged BL-1 scope and cost pins.
cases.expect: BL-2 is a complete atomic package while unchanged dimensions remain traceable to their immutable pins.

cases.input: A milestone is recorded met with effective time, authority and evidence while related tasks remain independently tracked.
cases.expect: Achievement is valid without collapsing task completion into milestone identity.

cases.input: One long-lived Jira project is declared to be one business Project for all initiatives.
cases.expect: The profile rejects tracker-container identity as Project identity.

cases.input: Approving CR-7 overwrites BL-1 in place.
cases.expect: The mutation is rejected; approval may only trigger a successor baseline.

cases.input: BL-1 references the current mutable plan head instead of an immutable revision or snapshot.
cases.expect: The package is rejected because later plan edits would rewrite BL-1 meaning.

cases.input: A deliverable row is updated in place to represent its acceptance decision.
cases.expect: The update is rejected; Acceptance requires a separate immutable identity and pinned basis.

cases.input: A copied plan snapshot inside BL-1 is edited and treated as the authoritative WM-ACT-008 plan revision.
cases.expect: The edit is rejected because snapshots are non-authoritative copies with immutable source provenance.

cases.input: BL-2 automatically reopens every acceptance bound to BL-1 without an impact assertion.
cases.expect: The automatic reopening is rejected; re-verification requires explicit approved-change impact.

cases.input: A completed task automatically marks a milestone achieved without milestone evidence.
Closing project P-A retires shared product X and deletes its open change requests.
cases.expect: Both effects are rejected; product and unresolved obligations retain separate lifecycles.
